measured_siblings.summary: Dartman two-player board game rules: pieces P1/X1/X2 (Player 1) and P2/Y1/Y2 (Player 2); Dartman (P1/P2) moves with momentum — slides until hitting own deflector or board edge, cannot use opposing deflector as stopping point; 1x2 Deflector must stay vertical; win condition Player 2 = P2 at (b,7), Y1 at (b,8), Y2 at (a,8) and (a,7); Dartman cannot enter line of fire of opposing Dartman without a deflector between them
